en:letter.enDefinition: A symbol in an alphabet. · A written or printed communication, usually defined as longer and more formal than a note. (Sometimes specifically one that is on paper.) · The literal meaning of something, as distinguished from its intended and remoter meaning (the spirit). · Literature.

en:fool.enDefinition: A person with poor judgment or little intelligence. · A stock character typified by unintelligence, naïveté or lucklessness, usually as a form of comic relief; often used as a source of insight or pathos for the audience, as such characters are generally less bound by social expectations. · Someone who has been made a fool of or tricked; dupe. · Someone who derives pleasure from something specified.
en:fool.deDefinition: Idiot, Dummkopf, Narr · Sahnespeise aus Obstpüree (brit.)

en:attention.enDefinition: Mental focus. · An action or remark expressing concern for or interest in someone or something, especially romantic interest. · A state of alertness in the standing position. · A kind of prioritisation technique in neural networks that assigns soft weights between tokens from two (or more) input sequences in order to compute the required output.
en:attention.deDefinition: Aufmerksamkeit, Beachtung, Vorsicht, Umsicht, Sorgfalt, Acht, Fürsorge, Augenmerk, Rücksichtnahme, Ansprache, Aufsicht · Berücksichtigung, Erledigung, Behandlung · Aufmerksamkeit, Freundlichkeit, (Mehrzahl) Aufmerksamkeiten, Zuwendung, Zuvorkommenheit · Vorsicht!, (Militär) Achtung!, Stillgestanden!, Habt Acht!, (nautisch) Wahrschau!

en:interesting.enDefinition: Arousing or holding the attention or interest of someone. · Pregnant. (used with situation and condition) · uninteresting, boring, soggy

en:box.enDefinition: shrub or tree of the genus Buxus — see also box tree
en:box.pairedSense: shrub or tree of the genus Buxus — see also box tree

en:group.definition: grup, küme, öbek · müzik yapmak üzere biraraya gelen insanların oluşturduğu topluluk, sanatçı grubu, topluluk · takım · heyet
en:group.enDefinition: A number of things or persons being in some relation to one another. · A set with an associative binary operation, under which there exists an identity element, and such that each element has an inverse. · A (usually small) group of people who perform music together. · A small number (up to about fifty) of galaxies that are near each other.

en:single.enDefinition: Not accompanied by anything else; one in number. · Not divided in parts. · Designed for the use of only one. · Performed by one person, or one on each side.

en:sitting.enDefinition: A period during which one is seated for a specific purpose. · A seance or other session with a medium or fortuneteller. · A special seat allotted to a seat-holder, at church, etc. · The part of the year in which judicial business is transacted.
en:sitting.deDefinition: zweckgebundene Sitzungsperiode für ein Essen, Portrait und Ähnliches · politische Tagung

en:marriage.enDefinition: The state of being married. · A union of two or more people that creates a family tie and carries legal, social, or religious rights and responsibilities. · The union of only two people, to the exclusion of all others. · The union of two people of opposite sex, to the exclusion of all others.

en:join.enDefinition: To connect or combine into one; to put together. · To come together; to meet. · To enter into association or alliance, to unite in a common purpose. · To start working on or participating in a project.
en:join.deDefinition: verbinden, vereinigen · sich gesellen, sich anschließen, eintreten (in einen Verein) · sich vereinigen, sich verbinden mit · münden in

en:fear.enDefinition: A strong, unpleasant emotion or feeling caused by actual or perceived danger or threat. · A phobia, a sense of fear induced by something or someone in particular. · Something one is afraid of; the object of one’s fear. · Terrified veneration or reverence, particularly towards God, gods, or sovereigns.

en:short.enDefinition: Having a small distance from one end or edge to another, either horizontally or vertically. · Of a person, living being, or object, having a comparatively small height. · Having little duration. · Of a word or phrase, constituting an abbreviation (for another) or shortened form (of another).

en:present.enDefinition: Relating to now, for the time being; current. · Located in the immediate vicinity. · Relating to something a person is referring to in the very context, with a deictic use similar to the demonstrative adjective this. · Attentive; alert; focused.

en:enjoy.enDefinition: To receive pleasure or satisfaction from something. · To have the use or benefit of something. · To be satisfied or receive pleasure; to have fun. · To have sexual intercourse with.

en:crime.enDefinition: A specific act committed in violation of the law, especially criminal law. · Any great sin or wickedness; iniquity. · Criminal acts collectively. · The habit or practice of committing crimes.

en:ground.enDefinition: The surface of the Earth, as opposed to the sky or water or underground. · Terrain. · Soil, earth. · The bottom of a body of water.

en:count.enDefinition: To recite numbers in sequence. · To determine the number of (objects in a group). · To amount to, to number in total. · To be of significance; to matter; to be considered (as something); to be included (of something).

en:area.enDefinition: A measure of the extent of a surface; it is measured in square units. · A particular geographic region. · Any particular extent of surface, especially an empty or unused extent. · The extent, scope, or range of an object or concept.
en:area.deDefinition: bestimmtes geographisches Gebiet · Ausmaß eines umgrenzten Bereichs

en:charge.definition: akın, saldırı, hücum · yükleme, doldurma, şarj
en:charge.enDefinition: The amount of money levied for a service. · An attack in which combatants rush towards an enemy in an attempt to engage in close combat. · A forceful forward movement. · An official description (by the police or a court) of a crime that somebody may be guilty of.

en:honor.enDefinition: Recognition of importance or value; respect; veneration (of someone, usually for being morally upright or successful). · The state of being morally upright, honest, noble, virtuous, and magnanimous; excellence of character; the perception of such a state; favourable reputation; dignity. · A token of praise or respect; something that represents praiseworthiness or respect, such as a prize or award given by the state to a citizen. · A privilege (which honors the person experiencing it).

en:lunch.enDefinition: A light meal usually eaten around midday, notably when not as main meal of the day. · A break in play between the first and second sessions. · Any small meal, especially one eaten at a social gathering.

en:miles.enDefinition: A great distance in space or time.

en:radio.enDefinition: The technology that allows for the transmission of sound or other signals by modulation of electromagnetic waves. · A device that can capture (receive) the signal sent over radio waves and render the modulated signal as sound. · Any audio playing device, such as the on-board entertainment system in a car, usually including a radio receiver as well as the capability to play audio from recorded media; see also car radio. · A device that can transmit radio signals.
en:radio.deDefinition: das Senden und Empfangen elektromagnetischer Wellen bestimmter Frequenzen · das Betreiben und Durchführen von Rundfunk als Hörfunk · ein Gerät zum Empfang des Hörfunks · ein Funkgerät als Sender und Empfänger für persönlichen Sprechfunk

en:idiot.enDefinition: A person of low general intelligence. · A person who makes stupid decisions; a fool.

en:paper.enDefinition: A sheet material typically used for writing on or printing on (or as a non-waterproof container), usually made by draining cellulose fibres from a suspension in water. · Ellipsis of newspaper; anything used as such (such as a newsletter or listing magazine). · Ellipsis of wallpaper. · Ellipsis of wrapping paper.
en:paper.deDefinition: Papier · die Abhandlung, die Akte, der Fachvortrag, die Veröffentlichung, das Dokument · die Zeitung

en:key.enDefinition: device designed to open and close a lock
en:key.pairedSense: device designed to open and close a lock

en:boat.enDefinition: A small, usually open craft used for travelling over water, propelled by oars, motor or wind. Usually contrasted with "ship". · A submarine. · A large, ocean-going ship. · A shallow jug used to serve sauces or other liquid foods.

en:quickly.enDefinition: Rapidly; with speed; fast; with expedition. · Very soon.

en:gold.enDefinition: (uncountable) A heavy yellow elemental metal of great value, with atomic number 79. · A coin or coinage made of this material, or supposedly so. · A deep yellow colour, resembling the metal gold. · The bullseye of an archery target.

en:bar.definition: çikolata, gofret, sabun v.s. kalıbı · demir çubuk · bar
en:bar.enDefinition: A solid, more or less rigid object of metal or wood with a uniform cross-section smaller than its length. · A solid metal object with uniform (round, square, hexagonal, octagonal or rectangular) cross-section; in the US its smallest dimension is ¹⁄₄ inch or greater, a piece of thinner material being called a strip. · A cuboid piece of any solid commodity. · A broad shaft, band, or stripe.

Q152.enDefinition: A typically cold-blooded vertebrate animal that lives in water, moving with the help of fins and breathing with gills; any vertebrate that is not a tetrapod. · Any vertebrate, including tetrapods. · Cod; codfish. · The flesh of the fish used as food.

en:mark.enDefinition: A stone or post used to indicate position and guide travellers. · The line indicating an athlete's starting-point. · An omen; a symptomatic indicator of something. · A characteristic feature.
en:mark.deDefinition: Fleck; Narbe, Mal (auf der Haut), Brandmal (von Verbrennung); Kratzer, Schramme; Spur, Narbe; Abdruck · Kennzeichen, Merkmal, Zeichen, Kennung · Markierung, Vermerk · Satzzeichen

en:wearing.enDefinition: Intended to be worn. · Causing tiredness; trying to a person's patience. · Causing erosion. · That wears (deteriorate through use), and may eventually wear out.

en:crying.enDefinition: That cries. · That demands action or attention; desperate. · That deserves rebuke or censure; deplorable.

en:government.enDefinition: The body with the power to make and/or enforce laws to control a country, land area, people or organization. · The relationship between a word and its dependents. · The state and its administration viewed as the ruling political power. · The management or control of a system.

en:eight.enDefinition: A numerical value equal to 8; the number occurring after seven and before nine. · Describing a group or set with eight elements.

en:fell.enDefinition: To make something fall; especially a tree. · To strike down, kill, destroy. · To stitch down a protruding flap of fabric, as a seam allowance, or pleat.

en:interested.enDefinition: Having or showing interest (attention or curiosity). · Having an interest (stake); being a stakeholder; motivated by considerations of self-interest; self-serving. · Owning a share of a company; being a shareholder.

en:deep.enDefinition: Extending far down from the top, or surface, to the bottom, literally or figuratively. · Positioned far from the surface or other reference point, especially down through something or into something. · Positioned far from the boundaries of or main approaches to (the specified place); interior. · Far in extent in another (non-downwards, but generally also non-upwards) direction, especially front-to-back.

en:star.enDefinition: a celestial body appearing as a point of light on the clear night sky, whose position is relatively fixed with respect to each other
en:star.pairedSense: a celestial body appearing as a point of light on the clear night sky, whose position is relatively fixed with respect to each other

en:agree.enDefinition: To be in harmony about an opinion, statement, or action; to have a consistent idea between two or more people. · To give assent; to accede. · To yield assent to; to approve. · To make a stipulation by way of settling differences or determining a price; to exchange promises; to come to terms or to a common resolve; to promise.
en:agree.deDefinition: vereinbaren, verständigen, absprechen · sich bereiterklären, einverstanden sein · etwas bekommt jemandem gut, gut bekommen, bekömmlich sein

en:detective.enDefinition: A police officer tasked with collecting evidence and information in order to solve a crime; an investigator. · A person employed to find information not otherwise available to the public.

en:prison.definition: cezaevi, hapis, hapishane, mahpushane, mahbes, kodes, içeri
en:prison.enDefinition: A place or institution where people are held against their will, in the US especially for long-term confinement, as of those convicted of serious crimes or otherwise considered undesirable by the government. · Confinement in prison (sense 1). · Any restrictive environment, such as a harsh academy or home.

en:difficult.enDefinition: Hard, not easy, requiring much effort. · Hard to manage, uncooperative, troublesome.

en:smart.enDefinition: To hurt or sting. · To cause a smart or sting in. · To feel a pungent pain of mind; to feel sharp pain or grief; to be punished severely; to feel the sting of evil.
en:smart.deDefinition: sich stechend schmerzhaft anfühlen · sich aufgebracht und zornig fühlen

en:personal.enDefinition: Pertaining to persons (human beings as opposed to things or animals). · Of or pertaining to a particular person; relating to, or affecting, an individual, or each of many individuals · Dealing with subjects about which one wishes (or people usually wish) to maintain privacy or discretion; not for public view; sensitive, intimate. · Intended for sexual use.
en:personal.deDefinition: einer bestimmten einzelnen Person zugeordnet · dem privaten Bereich einer Person zugeordnet

en:stopped.enDefinition: A (usually marked) place where buses, trams or trains halt to let passengers get on and off, usually smaller than a station. · An action of stopping; interruption of travel. · That which stops, impedes, or obstructs; an obstacle; an impediment. · A device intended to block the path of a moving object

en:hide.enDefinition: The skin of an animal. · One's own life or personal safety, especially when in peril. · (mainly British) A covered structure from which hunters, birdwatchers, etc can observe animals without scaring them. · A secret room for hiding oneself or valuables; a hideaway.
en:hide.deDefinition: die Haut eines Tiers · das Fell eines Tiers · Leder das aus der Haut oder des Fells eines Tiuers gegerbt wird · ein Hochsitz

en:whether.enDefinition: Introduces a simple indirect question (without a correlative). · Indicates doubt between possibilities (usually with correlative or). · Introduces a disjunctive adverbial clause qualifying the main clause (with correlative or).

en:bank.definition: banka · bir nehir yatağının her iki yanı boyunca uzanan eğimli yüzey
en:bank.enDefinition: An institution where one can place and borrow money and take care of financial affairs. · A branch office of such an institution. · An underwriter or controller of a card game. · A fund from deposits or contributions, to be used in transacting business; a joint stock or capital.
en:bank.deDefinition: Bank, Geldinstitut für Finanzdienstleistungen · Bank, allgemein für eine geschützte Aufbewahrungsstätte · Damm, Fahrdamm · Ufer, Uferböschung (von Flüssen oder Seen)

en:relax.enDefinition: To make something loose. · To become loose. · To relieve (someone or someone's mind) of stress; to enable to rest; to calm down. · To rest and become relieved of stress.

en:public.enDefinition: Able to be known or seen by everyone; happening without concealment; open to general view. · Open to all members of a community, as opposed to only a segment of it; especially, provided by national or local authorities and supported by money from taxes. · Of a company: having shares of stock traded publicly, for example, through a stock market. · Pertaining to the people as a whole, as opposed to a group of people; concerning the whole community or country.

en:list.enDefinition: A strip of fabric, especially from the edge of a piece of cloth. · Material used for cloth selvage. · A register or roll of paper consisting of a compilation or enumeration of a set of possible items; the compilation or enumeration itself. · A codified representation of a list used to store data or in processing; especially, in the Lisp programming language, a data structure consisting of a sequence of zero or more items.
en:list.deDefinition: strukturierte Sammlung an Daten, die im Zusammenhang stehen (können); Liste

en:afternoon.enDefinition: The part of the day from noon or lunchtime until sunset, evening, or suppertime or 6pm. · The later part of anything, often with implications of decline. · A party or social event held in the afternoon.
en:afternoon.deDefinition: Tageszeit zwischen Mittag und Abend; Nachmittag

en:service.enDefinition: To serve. · To perform maintenance. · To supply (media outlets) with press releases etc. · To make a repayment or pay interest (on a debt).

en:screaming.enDefinition: to make the sound of a scream
en:screaming.pairedSense: to make the sound of a scream

en:forward.deDefinition: vorder · vordere · vorderer · vorausgerichtet · vorauszielend · vorderst

en:angry.enDefinition: Displaying or feeling anger. · Inflamed and painful. · Dark and stormy, menacing.

en:soul.enDefinition: The spirit or essence of a person usually thought to consist of one's thoughts and personality, often believed to live on after the person's death. · The spirit or essence of anything. · Life, energy, vigor. · Cultural consciousness and pride among people of African American heritage.

en:fighting.enDefinition: Engaged in war or other conflict. · Apt to provoke a fight.

en:agent.enDefinition: One who exerts power, or has the power to act. · One who acts for, or in the place of, another (the principal), by that person's authority; someone entrusted to act on behalf of or in behalf of another, such as to transact business for them. · A person who looks for work for another person and brokers a deal between the hiree and hirer. · Someone who works for an intelligence agency: whether an officer or employee thereof or anyone else who agrees to help their efforts (for ideology, for money, as blackmailee, or otherwise).
en:agent.deDefinition: eine Sache oder auch Person, die etwas Bestimmtes bewirkt · eine Person oder auch Gesellschaft, die von einer zweiten beauftragt ist, zu Teilen deren Geschäft zu besorgen · Agens

en:blow.enDefinition: To produce an air current. · To propel by an air current (or, if under water, a water current), usually with the mouth. · To be propelled by an air current. · To direct or move, usually of a person to a particular location.
en:blow.deDefinition: blasen (allgemein Luft bewegen) · pusten · wehen (Wind) · vermasseln

en:dress.enDefinition: intransitive: to put on clothes — see also get dressed, wear, put on
en:dress.pairedSense: intransitive: to put on clothes — see also get dressed, wear, put on

en:scene.enDefinition: The location of an event that attracts attention. · The decorations; furnishings, and backgrounds of a stage, representing the place in which the action of a play is set. · A part of a dramatic work that is set in the same place or time. In the theatre, generally a number of scenes constitute an act. · The location, time, circumstances, etc., in which something occurs, or in which the action of a story, play, or the like, is set up.
en:scene.deDefinition: Sequenz ununterbrochener, zusammenhängender Handlung in einem Theaterstück, Film, Oper oder Buch

en:killing.enDefinition: That literally deprives of life; lethal, deadly, fatal. · That makes one ‘die’ with laughter; very funny.

en:standing.enDefinition: Erect, not cut down. · Performed from an erect position. · Remaining in force or status; ongoing. · Stagnant; not moving or flowing.

en:saved.definition: para biriktirmek, tasarruf etmek · kurtarmak · idareli kullanmak · engellemek
en:saved.enDefinition: To help (somebody) to survive, or rescue (somebody or something) from harm. · To keep (something) safe; to safeguard. · To spare (somebody) from effort, or from something undesirable. · To redeem or protect someone from eternal damnation.

en:mm.enDefinition: Abbreviation of month, in two-digit numeric format, as in: dd/mm/yyyy.

en:respect.enDefinition: An attitude of consideration or high regard; a feeling of admiration or esteem. · Good opinion, honor, or admiration. · Polite greetings, often offered as condolences after a death. · A particular aspect, feature or detail of something.
